messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU queue length rising rapidly in us-west-2. Autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes (quota/limit reached). Potential customer impact. Link: https://rwd/io/inc/1718217600 :rotating_light:

sam_hayes: taking this. oncall here. checking autoscaler and GPU pool now.

maya_g: saw spikes in 95th latency and a flood of throttle logs ~10:06 UTC, looks correlated with a recent model rollout (traffic -> redwood/long-context-8k-v2).

oncall_bob: paging infra team and infra-eng. dm if you need escalation to SRE.

sam_hayes: commands I'm running:
```
# check HPA / autoscaler state
kubectl get hpa -n inference
kubectl describe hpa inference-gpu-pool
# check GPU pool / nodegroup
gcloud compute instance-groups managed list --filter="name~gpu-pool-us-west2"
```

sam_hayes: autoscaler logs show repeated "Reached maxReplicas" and API server returning 429/503 for allocation requests. Also seeing OOM-like evictions on some GPU nodes.

infra_eng: confirmed nodegroup hit quota: project GPU quota at 32 GPUs, current requested would require +24. Cloud provider rejected new instances with QuotaExceeded. Ticket to cloud support opened (CS-9123).

irene_ops: customer-impact snapshot: 12 customers reported increased 5xx errors, API 95th latency jumped to 12s, request queue length peaked ~2500. Most affected routes: /v1/chat/stream and /v1/generate for model redwood/long-context-8k-v2.

maya_g: digging into model behavior — long-context-8k-v2 has larger KV-cache per session and the rollout increased typical context length usage due to a bug in our prompt-expansion wrapper (it stopped truncating system tokens). Effective per-request memory up ~2.8x. That explains sudden capacity hit.

sam_hayes: mitigation plan (immediate):
1) Pause rollout: divert new traffic away from long-context-8k-v2 to v2-stable. (deploy-bot, can we rollback / reroute?)
2) Increase autoscaler maxReplicas temporarily if cloud quota allows; otherwise, request emergency quota increase.
3) Activate rate-limiter for bursty tenants and add 503 backoff for non-critical traffic.
4) Notify CS so they can inform affected customers.

deploy-bot: routing change queued: traffic-split for model long-context-8k updated to 15% -> 0% (canary aborted). Applying now.

deploy-bot: done — traffic split reverted to v2-stable for all routes.

sam_hayes: starting controlled rollout rollback config: 
```
POST /internal/traffic-routing
{"model":"redwood/long-context-8k-v2","pct":0}
```

infra_eng: cloud quota increase estimate 20-30 min for approval; in parallel we can fail open some lower-priority queues and drain long-running sessions.

maya_g: also pushing a hotfix to prompt-expansion to re-enable truncation. Build 0.3.7 will be deployed to the runtime pool to prevent new sessions from growing context sizes.

irene_ops: CS note drafted: "We experienced elevated latencies and intermittent 5xx errors 10:05–11:00 UTC due to autoscaling limits triggered by a model rollout that increased per-session GPU memory. Mitigations applied: rollout paused, traffic routed to stable model, and hotfix deployed. We will follow up with root cause and postmortem." Sending to account owners now.

sam_hayes: quick health check numbers after rollback and rate limiting: queue length down to ~300, 95th latency back to ~1.4s, throttles decreasing. Still seeing occasional node eviction traces.

oncall_bob: handing off to maya_g for follow-up and postmortem. Summary for handoff:
- cause: rollout of redwood/long-context-8k-v2 + prompt-expansion bug -> larger contexts -> ~2.8x GPU memory per request
- symptom: autoscaler hit maxReplicas + cloud GPU quota -> requests queued/throttled -> customer-facing 5xx
- mitigation: paused rollout, routed traffic to v2-stable, deployed prompt-expansion hotfix, requested quota increase, applied rate-limits to bursty tenants
- current status: stable, monitoring for 30m, quota request pending

maya_g: taking over. will own postmortem and follow-up actions. Next steps I'm tracking:
- coordinate with infra to confirm quota increase or plan for dedicated reserved capacity for high-context models
- add regression test to eval harness to detect KV-cache/regression in per-request memory
- rollback policy: require perf smoke tests on new model variants with metrics on KV-cache and per-request GPU memory
- update rollout runbook to include immediate traffic cut to 0% on "Reached maxReplicas" autoscaler errors

customer_success: any customers asking for credits or incidents? A few enterprise customers flagged with priority; we're prepping tailored messages.

maya_g: noted. Irene, can you pull a list of impacted enterprise tenants so CS can prioritize outreach?

irene_ops: list pulled and shared to #customer-notifications.

sam_hayes: monitoring window: we'll watch for 60m. If queue remains <500 and 5xx rate <1% for 60m, mark mitigated.

deploy-bot: autoscaler logs show no further "maxReplicas" prints in last 8m.

incident-bot: UPDATE: Incident severity reduced to P2. Mitigations applied. Continue monitoring.

maya_g: setting up postmortem board. Preliminary RCA: rollout validation gap + missing per-model memory budget enforcement + prompt-expansion truncation bug. We'll propose: per-model memory cap, rollout canary traffic limits, smoke-perf tests, and emergency traffic-cut automation.

oncall_bob: thanks all. leaving notes for rotation: next oncall should watch the quota ticket and ensure CS messages go out.

sam_hayes: resolved for now. I'll close the primary incident once 60m clean. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: RESOLVED: Queue growth mitigated, traffic reroute and hotfix deployed. Incident resolved at 11:00 UTC. Postmortem assigned to maya_g.
